sites.layout:
(terrace behind the wall: dead shrubs, the way up round the wall end; optional keeper's hut)
  outcrop | ====== back wall, AB fort wall x4 (2.4 m showing) ====== | woodpile

sites.notes: Story set V7. Own site id (tag SD_V7_LastWaystation); the S19 V1 pieces it replaces are cleared with the V1 tool by id (clear_v1). The dead spare, the plaque lettering and the banner are this set's `rig` step. Nothing religious, nothing modern; the lantern and the fire are cold.
